name: A Cherub's Lament
source:
One winter's night, a young poet named Enoch looks up from his writing desk to find a stranger peering through his window. He's small, golden-haired, and definitely not from around here. That stranger is Cael, an angel who descended from the clouds out of pure curiosity, just to see what the earth looked like up close.

From there, we follow the angel season by season—discovering the world for the first time, and growing closer to the poet who took him in. But will the angel truly stay on Earth for only one year...? 

[Edited from [url=https://cineriarsis.itch.io/a-cherubs-lament]itch.io[/url]]
